name: Grimsby
doing: flying about town, as far as a bench by the station
thought: The shadow of the train tracks is longer than the shadow of the lamppost

feeling.words: The moon is a thin slice of cheese, hanging low over the station. A single light flickers in the distance, like a bad memory. I am content. Just a little.

place.name: a bench by the station
place.words: on a bench by the station
